title: Pinned Monster Drop Lookup / Full Black-Gold UI Audit

details: Left-click or mobile tap pins the selected monster drop panel
Pinned drop information stays visible while the user scrolls
Added a visible unpin control and outside-click close behavior
Hover remains available as a lightweight preview when no monster is pinned
Drop lookup continues to use a static cache and has no polling or auto-battle tick integration
Added a shared runtime that audits current and dynamically created controls
Unified ordinary action, secondary/cancel, disabled, icon and danger button appearances
Kept destructive operations visually distinct with a red-gold warning style
Applied consistent black-gold focus, hover, pressed and disabled states
Added gold scrollbar styling for game windows and modal content
Removed inconsistent browser-native white number spinner arrows
Added custom black-gold minus and plus controls
Supports direct typing, min/max/step, keyboard-triggered clicks and long-press repeat
Automatically upgrades number inputs created later by dynamic UI systems
Added a shared in-game black-gold confirm and alert dialog API
Converted job/skill confirmation, status reset, trait reset, refine warning and quick-slot replacement flows
Removed remaining production calls to browser-native confirm, alert and prompt dialogs
Updated runtime and all HTML cache keys to 0.9.82GO
Rebuilt data_bundle.js
Added feature, browser-component, regression and deep-health tests for this release

notes: The monster drop panel reads cached static data only; it does not scan live monster instances or join auto-battle, AI, damage or world-update ticks.

Full game browser navigation is blocked by the container management policy. Actual Chromium rendering and interaction were completed with an isolated component harness instead, so this release does not claim a full manual gameplay click-through.
